data.body: Closing without AC #4 met. The code fix (description shortened to 97 chars, check_mcp_registry_description guard added + wired into release.yml's authorize job, unit tests added) merged via Gerrit change 2387 (commit af915ac63bb1) and is verified in-repo (guard step present, tests pass). AC #4 (a successful re-run of the MCP Registry publish job) cannot be satisfied: the parent release effort (hyperbolic-pernicious-drongo) has been abandoned -- v0.13.0's MCP Registry entry was never published, and the release will not be resumed. Closing this ticket on the strength of the verified code fix; the unmet non-codebase AC is an artifact of the abandoned release, not a defect in this fix.
